body.text: Sir — we have not met, and I hope we shall not have to.

My people at the southern anchorage report that your settlement at {param:town} is prospering, and that its stores are better kept than mine. I congratulate you. I am obliged to add that they are also nearer to me than to you.
I ask for {param:amount} of {param:resource}. I do not ask it as a duty, and I am not entitled to it, and we may both be clear that this is not a trade.

You will understand that I am not threatening you. I am describing a difficulty I have, which is that my captains are idle and my season is long. Should it be resolved I expect I shall not need to write again for some while.
Your Crown will not hear of this from me. I find these things are generally heard of anyway.

tone.text: To the Governor of the Windward Coast — I write {choice}.

options.label: send the goods
options.text: The goods will be sent. I trust your season improves.

options.label: refuse him
options.text: You will have nothing from me, this season or any other.
